steps.en: Install the binary and configure an Apple API-key profile
steps.zh: 安装二进制并配置苹果 API 密钥

steps.en: Validate the profile and request a JSON app listing
steps.zh: 核验配置并请求 JSON 应用列表

steps.en: Sign the request locally with the configured key
steps.zh: 使用配置的密钥在本地签名请求

steps.en: Fetch Apple account data and return script-readable app IDs
steps.zh: 读取苹果账户数据并返回脚本可用的应用编号

value.en: Use account data in automation without clicking through the web console
value.zh: 不用反复点后台，就能把账户数据接入自动化
